title: The Super Mario Bros. Super Show!
description: In Pasta Land, King Koopa uses a magical flute to lure all the local Mushroom children away from the town, and leads them to his nearby castle.

title: The Mask
description: Milo is infected with a computer virus.

title: Police Academy: The Animated Series
description: The further adventures of the Police Academy gang.

title: ALF: The Animated Series
description: Gordon, Rick and Skip buy a sailing yacht, but end up marooned on an island.

title: ALF Tales
description: ALF and his friends present their entertaining version of "Little Red Riding Hood", a 17th-century European classic tale about an unsuspecting little girl who faces a scary predator.

title: Yogi's Treasure Hunt
description: Yogi and friends find themselves reliving the story of Jack and the Beanstalk.

title: Yogi's Treasure Hunt
description: Toys are being stolen from their homes and brought to a mysterious planet.

title: Captain Planet and the Planeteers
description: The Planeteers thwart Looten Plunder's scheme to eradicate the elephant population in Africa to harvest the ivory.

title: Captain Planet and the Planeteers
description: Hoggish Greedly and Rigger go fishing using drift nets and manage to steal the Planeteers' rings.

title: Histeria!
description: A look at President Richard Nixon and John F. Kennedy, along with the Watergate scandal, then Rally At The Beach with Pepper!

title: Histeria!
description: The show looks at the Great Woman World Leaders Therapy Group and the Pastry War, along with another round of "Ask Me If I Care" with Mohandas Gandhi.

title: The New Scooby-Doo Movies
description: The Harlem Globetrotters and the gang spend a night on a haunted island.

title: Josie and the Pussycats in Outer Space
description: Aliens develop a ray that turns adults into children.

title: Pebbles & Bamm-Bamm
description: Pebbles accidentally gives Fred's secret fuel formula to the junkman.

title: Top Cat
description: When Officer Dibble accidentally overhears a conversation between Top Cat and his doctor, he believes his friend has only one week left to live.

title: Hong Kong Phooey
description: An impostor tries to claim Phooey's rewards for fighting crime; Phooey examines how a mechanical claw is stealing gold from the bank.

title: Jonny Quest
description: Dr. Quest heads to the land of the Turu in the Amazon in pursuit of high-grade trinoxite, a new metal essential to the space program, not knowing that Turu is a live pteranodon guarding the deposit.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: A nerd-turned-muscleman captures three of the Turtles; Leonardo must ask for help in rescuing them.

title: Super Friends
description: A mysterious blue jet is causing havoc.

title: Legion of Super Heroes
description: The Legion sentences Timber Wolf to prison for the assault of his father; however, Phantom Girl and Chameleon Boy believe that he is innocent and work to clear his name.

title: The New Space Ghost and Herculoids Show
description: The evil Wizard creates a spaceship with a mind-controlling device in 'Devil Ship.' Two space travelers journey to Quasar to be reunited with their descendants in 'Return Of The Ancients.' Space Ghost battles the commander and his remote-control device in 'The Deadly Comet.'.

title: The Tom and Jerry Show
description: Tom, Jerry, Droopy Dog and many other classic MGM theatrical cartoon stars; the work of Tex Avery, Hanna-Barbera and other top Hollywood animators is featured.

title: Yo, Yogi!
description: The Abdominal Snowdude causes trouble with skiers.

title: Yogi's First Christmas
description: With the help of a curmudgeonly hermit, a bratty young boy named Snively schemes to scare away guests and undermine the annual Christmas carnival at his aunt's resort in scenic Jellystone National Park. Roused from peaceful hibernation by noisy revelers, a frazzled Yogi Bear (Daws Butler) and his trusty sidekick, Boo Boo (Don Messick), investigate, eventually joining in the festivities -- much to the chagrin of Yogi's erstwhile arch rival, Ranger Smith (also Messick).

title: House of Hanna-Barbera
description: Back-to-back classic cartoons from the legendary Hanna-Barbera animation studios.

title: Bugs Bunny and Friends
description: The greatest animated characters and cartoons produced at Warner Bros. legendary Termite Terrace; Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Road Runner and all their friends are featured here weekly.

title: Cartoon All-Stars
description: The biggest names in classic cartoons get the animation spotlight in these best-of collections featuring cartoon favorites from the golden age of Hollywood animation include shorts from Warner Bros, MGM studios, Columbia, Fleischer and others.

title: Star Trek: The Animated Series
description: The Enterprise finds a long-lost explorer (Ted Knight).

title: Duck Dodgers
description: Duck Dodgers gains a Green Lantern uniform after a dry cleaner mix-up.

title: 2 Stupid Dogs
description: Big Dog gets mistaken for a foreign dignitary.

title: Freakazoid
description: A rabid dog-like creature becomes Freak's new sidekick; Lord Bravery fights bureaucracy over his name; Fan Boy rhapsodizes over his quest for Spock's autograph; Freak teaches Norwegian.

title: The Mask
description: As the Mask, Stanley meets his favorite cartoon characters.

title: Beetlejuice
description: Beetlejuice, Lydia and Doomie crash into a Netherworld town.

title: The Real Ghostbusters
description: A shape-shifter and a giant five-headed dragon elude the boys.

title: SilverHawks
description: Hardware hatches a plot aimed at using Tally-Hawk to kill Quicksilver.

title: Pac-Man
description: Mezmaron builds a robotic clone of Pepper to fool Pac-Man; Pac-Man with Pepper and Mezmaron with the Ghost Monsters race to an area where Power Pellets are located; they are observed by a legendary monster, lurking in the hills.

title: Plastic Man
description: Solex breaks Plastic Man's worst enemies out from prison; Plastic Man faces Joggernaught.

title: Challenge of the GoBots
description: Cy-Kill flees to Earth in the wake of his failed coup.

title: Challenge of the GoBots
description: Cy-Kill and Dr. Braxis join forces to steal an experimental energy crystal.

title: The Completely Mental Misadventures of Ed Grimley
description: Miss Malone needs to learn how to drive and calls upon Ed to teach her; an accident turns the two into wandering spirits who haunt Mr. Freebus.

title: Mister T
description: While in Busted Springs, Ariz., Mr. T and his team solve the 75-year-old mystery behind the reason two families are still feuding.

title: Inspector Gadget
description: Dr. Claw asks a mobster's help to nab Gadget.

title: Inspector Gadget
description: M.A.D. agents pretend to be fans of Gadget.

title: Baby Looney Tunes
description: Sylvester becomes jealous of the attention that baby Pepe receives from the gang; Bugs tries to become a better magician.

title: Baby Looney Tunes
description: Daffy learns not to use foul language; Melissa instructs the gang to bake her a cake so she can eat it.

title: Casper and Company
description: Adventures of Casper, Little Audrey, Baby Huey, Herman and Katnip and many others.

title: The Tom and Jerry Show
description: Tom, Jerry, Droopy Dog and many other classic MGM theatrical cartoon stars; the work of Tex Avery, Hanna-Barbera and other top Hollywood animators is featured.

title: The Woody Woodpecker Show
description: A collection of timeless cartoon shorts that span from 1934 to 1972, featuring the mischievous Woody Woodpecker and his colorful cast of friends including Chilly Willy, The Beary Family, Inspector Willoughby, Andy Panda, and more.

title: Popeye and Pals
description: Popeye, Bluto, Olive Oyl and all his seafaring friends star in these original theatrical cartoons from the genius of Max Fleischer; included are Betty Boop and Bimbo shorts.

title: Bugs Bunny and Friends
description: The greatest animated characters and cartoons produced at Warner Bros. legendary Termite Terrace; Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Road Runner and all their friends are featured here weekly.

title: House of Hanna-Barbera
description: Back-to-back classic cartoons from the legendary Hanna-Barbera animation studios.

title: Mighty Mouse and Friends
description: Welcome to the House of Hanna-Barbera, where dozens of the animation duo's most beloved cartoons dwell; take a seat and be entertained by Huck, Yogi, Wally, Touché, Yakky and many more animated residents of this happy house.

title: Help! It's the Hair Bear Bunch!
description: When zookeeper Peevly makes the animals at the zoo clean up after themselves, Hair Bear holds a raffle for the chance to win Peevly's job.

title: A Flintstones Family Christmas
description: Fred Flintstone celebrates Christmas with his family.

title: The Flintstones
description: Fred plays Santa Claus at a department store.

title: Cave Kids
description: Pebbles and Bamm-Bamm visit the North Pole; they find a baby Christmas tree and cheer up a grumpy Snowbear.

title: Yogi Bear's All-Star Comedy Christmas Caper
description: Yogi escapes from Jellystone and hides out in a department store posing as the store's Santa. Along the way, he helps a little girl to rediscover her faith in Christmas.

title: The Smurfs
description: The Smurfs battle something more evil than Gargamel.

title: Sunday Night Cartoon All-Stars
description: Featuring all-time favorite cartoons and lost treasures from the golden age of Hollywood animation.
